strip_asm_file: run strip_asm.py to strip an input assembly file and write cleaned output to a file
process_asm: process raw assembly text to strip unwanted directives, comments, and normalize labels
transform_labels: transform assembly labels by normalizing them and removing unused label declarations
process_identifiers: process identifiers in an assembly line to normalize ELF and MachO naming differences
find_used_labels: find all used local labels referenced by jump instructions in assembly text
